note: City of Salisbury campground in the city park above a small fishing lake, beside the golf course: a row of back-in full-hookup RV pads along the park road, a few primitive tent sites ($10) and a shower house. Pay at the City Hall drop box (128 W 2nd St) or the City Clerk on arrival. Closed in winter; no dates posted. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: $30 a night ($500 a month), full hookups, shower house, closed in winter (no dates on the city page). Not waterfront confirmed (lake ~95 m off across the park road). Pin and phone OK.
flags: RATE: nightly rate found on the city page - '$30.00 per day', with $500 per month; written as the base fee with the monthly in fees.note, and the note no longer leads with the monthly.
SEASON: the city page says only 'Our campground is generally closed during the winter months' - no opening/closing dates anywhere on it; left as seasonal without dates.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. The lake (~25+ acres, a real lake) is ~95-130 m SW of the nearest (south) pads, across open lawn AND the park road along the shore, with shore trees; the city's own panorama from the RV row shows no water. A view from the south pads is possible but unconfirmed - stays down.

LONG-STAY TESTS: price $30 (under the $50 gate); nightly rate + phone on the city's own page, pay on arrival, no application/lease; no minimum stay; no nightly-share count published (passes); not a home community. Monthly is offered at $500, but neither the imagery (empty pads, leaf-off) nor the 2021 city panorama (empty pads) shows a parked-in seasonal look, and no review mentions long-term residents - reads as a nightly city campground.

GOOGLE: 4.1 / 9 reviews ('Great little campground by a small fishing lake. Water, sewer, 50 amp electric sites, back in only. $20 /nite', 8 years ago; one 3-years-ago complaint about harassment in the tent area). 50-amp is from that old review only - not written.
